note: The fourth route, and kg's third distinct refusal: `%c` with a NUL. Emacs builds the one-character string "\0". kg raises plain `error` -- "format %c character is out of range" -- not the `wrong-type-argument` its `char-to-string` gives, so a Phase 25.1 that teaches strings to hold a NUL has three separate kg refusals to retract, in three separate places.
